05 / About Montesano

Different disciplines.
One clear purpose.

Montesano is a founder-led, independent scientific, technical and operational practice.

Our interdisciplinary approach connects investigation with practical implementation, so each engagement is shaped by the challenge rather than a single discipline.

Founded and operated by Francesco Montesano, MSc Biology, with a background in computer information systems and environmental sustainability.

06 / Before we begin

A few practical questions.

Not every challenge requires a large engagement.

Do I need a formal project brief?

No. A short description of your situation is enough.

Can you work with our existing team?

Yes. We can work alongside your team or help with a specific part of your project.

Do you work remotely or onsite?

We offer remote support and discuss fieldwork or onsite visits when your project needs them.

How are scope and fees determined?

We discuss your needs and agree on the work, fees and expected deliverables before you decide to proceed.

Is support available after delivery?

Yes. We can discuss follow-up guidance, technical support and ongoing assistance as your needs evolve.

08 / Privacy & professional notice

Privacy & information handling.

Information you choose to share

The initial inquiry is intended only to establish contact and assess whether a request fits the practice’s capabilities. Please provide only your contact details and a short, non-sensitive description of your challenge. Do not send passwords, financial account details, medical records, confidential files or specimens.

External services

Contact by email is handled through email service providers, which have their own privacy practices. The client request form uses Google Forms; Google's services and applicable privacy terms apply. The commercial is embedded in this website rather than hosted through a third-party video player. The website requests its typeface from Google Fonts; your browser may connect to Google to retrieve it.

Access, retention, and requests

Do not exchange sensitive project information until the appropriate handling arrangements have been established. Any engagement involving such information requires prior agreement on necessary information, access, safeguards, storage, retention and deletion. To ask about information you submitted or request its correction or deletion, contact here4younsystems@gmail.com. Requests are handled subject to applicable legal or contractual obligations.

Professional scope

Montesano provides independent research, technical and operational support. Services do not include regulated professional sign-off, accredited laboratory testing or clinical services. Sample safety, suitable methods and feasibility of new systems are assessed before accepting relevant work. Developmental prototypes are not validated production systems. Project scope, fees, confidentiality and deliverables are agreed before work begins; specific outcomes cannot be guaranteed. Portfolio examples reflect prior research and professional experience, not company client commissions. Academic references do not imply affiliation with or endorsement by Lakehead University.
